download_model: download the pretrained polyencoder retrieval model for blended skill talk to the specified datapath
review_download_function: review the download function that fetches the multi_task model using ParlAI's download_models utility
summarize_download_function: summarize the download function that retrieves the v1.0 blended skill talk model archive
test_download_function: test the download function by calling it with a custom datapath directory
refactor_download_function: refactor the download function to support additional model versions or task datasets
